evidence.quotation: "Hammer Shot" does not target. You determine which monster is destroyed when "Hammer Shot" resolves.

notes: No cost or target; own open Main from hand/own Set. At resolution select highest current ATK among face-up Attack Position monsters on either field; controller chooses tied maximum, including own monsters. Requires at least one eligible monster. No modifiers yet: trusted current ATK equals definition ATK in runtime. Single-link pass-only; no general mixed Chain, negate, immunity or replacements. Exotic face-down Attack Position not supported. Historical printed wording remains pending.
